title: Couriers and Messengers
description: Pick up and deliver messages, documents, packages, and other items between offices or departments within an establishment or directly to other business concerns, traveling by foot, bicycle, motorcycle, automobile, or public conveyance.

tasks.text: Deliver and pick up medical records, lab specimens, and medications to and from hospitals and other medical facilities.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Physical delivery of items in real environments

tasks.text: Walk, ride bicycles, drive vehicles, or use public conveyances to reach destinations to deliver messages or materials.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on vehicle and equipment operation

dwas.name: Operate vehicles or material-moving equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Load vehicles with listed goods, ensuring goods are loaded correctly and taking precautions with hazardous goods.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical loading of materials or equipment

tasks.text: Receive messages or materials to be delivered, and information on recipients, such as names, addresses, telephone numbers, and delivery instructions, communicated via telephone, two-way radio, or in person.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Relaying information needs real-time human channel

dwas.name: Relay information between personnel.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Deliver messages and items, such as newspapers, documents, and packages, between establishment departments and to other establishments and private homes.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Physical delivery of items in real environments

tasks.text: Record information, such as items received and delivered and recipients' responses to messages.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record shipping information into structured fields

tasks.text: Unload and sort items collected along delivery routes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical unloading of materials and equipment

tasks.text: Sort items to be delivered according to the delivery route.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Sorting physical mail requires hands-on handling

tasks.text: Plan and follow the most efficient routes for delivering goods.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Routing analysis from shipping data; human approves

dwas.name: Analyze shipping information to make routing decisions.

tasks.text: Perform routine maintenance on delivery vehicles, such as monitoring fluid levels and replenishing fuel.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical maintenance of mechanical equipment

tasks.text: Obtain signatures and payments, or arrange for recipients to make payments.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Drafting aided; authorized signature human

dwas.name: Obtain written authorization to perform activities.

tasks.text: Unload goods from large trucks, and load them onto smaller delivery vehicles.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical lifting and loading of shipments

dwas.name: Load or unload materials used in construction or extraction.

tasks.text: Open, sort, and distribute incoming mail.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically distributing materials to people

dwas.name: Distribute materials to employees or customers.

tasks.text: Check with home offices after completed deliveries to confirm deliveries and collections and to receive instructions for other deliveries.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Real-time coworker coordination is relational work

dwas.name: Confer with coworkers to coordinate work activities.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Use telephone to deliver verbal messages.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Routine customer notifications largely automatable

dwas.name: Provide notifications to customers or patrons.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Perform general office or clerical work, such as filing materials, operating duplicating machines, or running errands.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Filing physical documents requires hands in the world
